name: Kesh
design_note: Starting unit. Balanced physical attacker. Highest-power charge action in the game.

name: Ansa
design_note: First recruit. Party heal plus cleanse. Back row so takes x0.70 physical.

name: Dorrek
design_note: Highest HP and DEF. Only unit with block 0.10. Charge action taunts for 3.

name: Vey
design_note: Fastest unit (SPD 124) and highest crit (0.12). 9-hit charge action rolls crit per hit.

name: Mirel
design_note: Highest MAG. AoE charge action with a DoT. Lowest HP.

name: Skarn
design_note: Roster expansion (5->10). Reckless crit-fisher - heavy crit bonus plus partial lifesteal on its charge.

name: Sorin
design_note: Roster expansion. Armor-piercing melee charge that also applies Frail - melee delivery, magic payload.

name: Nyra
design_note: Roster expansion. AoE charge that Enfeebles every foe - shuts down enemy offense from the back line.

name: Brenn
design_note: Roster expansion. Self Blurred plus self-taunt on its charge - the dodge-tank answer to Vow of Stone.

name: Sael
design_note: Roster expansion. Light party heal plus Hasted on its charge - trades raw healing for tempo.
